full_prompt_en: A traditional naturalistic animal painting shows a small white lamb resting beside a larger brown horned goat in a shaded mountain clearing. Dense blue-green foliage fills the left background, while a distant rocky valley opens behind the animals toward the upper right. A narrow area of deep turquoise sky appears above the mountain slopes rather than covering the entire background. The pale brown ridges rise through a soft haze, contrasting with the nearly black-green trees nearer the clearing. In the foreground, low grass and moss spread over uneven ground, interspersed with small rusty-red plants and muted ochre patches. The lamb lies across the lower-left area with its legs tucked beneath its rounded body. Its short fleece is ivory-white, with gentle cream shadows along the belly and flank. The head is held upright and turned slightly toward the viewer, showing a pale muzzle, soft drooping ears and dark eyes. Immediately behind and to its right, the larger goat has a broad brown body that remains low against the vegetation. Its legs are concealed, leaving the raised chest, neck and head as the clearest parts of the pose. A darker beard hangs below a pale grey-cream face, and the long muzzle angles slightly toward the right. Two ridged horns rise above the head with different visible curves: the horn on the left makes a broad outward arch, while the horn on the right appears narrower and more upright. Pale ears project beneath them. The brown fur shifts from warm highlights along the neck to dense shadow lower on the body. The animals form a compact group rather than isolated silhouettes, their light faces and the lamb’s pale back standing out against the surrounding dark foliage. Small strokes distinguish grass, low leaves and fur, while the distant mountain contours remain softer. Diffuse light touches the fleece, faces and upper horn ridges, with deeper cool shade enclosing the clearing. The overall composition balances the low white lamb at the left with the larger raised horned head at the right, holding both within a sheltered green foreground beneath a receding rocky landscape.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅传统自然主义动物绘画，一只白色小羊与一只较大的棕色有角山羊相伴，位于幽暗山间的林地空隙中。浓密蓝绿枝叶占据左侧背景，动物身后的岩石山谷则向右上方远远展开。深青绿色天空只在山坡上方露出一小片，并未覆盖整个背景。浅棕山脊从柔雾中升起，与林地近处近乎黑绿的树木形成对比。前景低草与苔藓铺在起伏地面上，夹杂细小锈红植物和低饱和赭色斑块。小羊横卧在左下方，双腿收在圆润身体下。短羊毛呈象牙白，腹部与侧身有轻浅奶油色阴影。它抬着头，略转向观者，浅色吻部、柔软下垂的耳朵和深色眼睛都可辨认。紧靠其后并偏右的位置，较大山羊宽阔的棕色身体低伏于植被旁。腿部被遮住，抬起的胸颈与头部是姿态中最清晰的部分。浅灰奶油色脸部下垂着较深胡须，长吻略朝右方。两只带环纹的角升至头顶，显露不同曲线：画面左侧的一只宽阔地向外弯拱，右侧的一只看起来较窄、较直立。浅色耳朵从角下伸出。棕毛由颈部暖色亮面转入身体下方浓影。两只动物形成紧凑组合，而非彼此分离的剪影；浅色面部与小羊背部从周围深色枝叶中显出。细小笔触区分草叶、低矮植被和毛发，远山轮廓则较柔。漫射光落在羊毛、脸和角上方的环纹处，较深冷影包住林地。整体构图以前方左侧低卧的白羊平衡右侧较高的有角头部，让它们同处于受枝叶庇护的绿色前景，后方岩石景观渐次退远。
style_prompt_en: The traditional naturalistic painting uses softly blended modelling, deep cool shadows and selective warm highlights. Blue-green and charcoal masses provide a dark setting for ivory, warm brown and muted ochre passages. Fine short marks distinguish tactile surface textures near the focal area, while distant transitions remain softer and less detailed. Contours alternate between clearly illuminated edges and passages that merge into shadow. Diffuse light preserves rounded volume without harsh outlines, and small rusty accents break the otherwise subdued colour field. The overall treatment is intimate and balanced, combining careful observation with broad atmospheric depth.
style_prompt_zh: 传统自然主义绘画采用柔和融合的塑形、深冷阴影和选择性的暖色高光。蓝绿与炭黑块面为象牙白、暖棕和低饱和赭色区域提供深色衬托。细短笔痕区分焦点附近可触的表面肌理，远处过渡则较柔且细节较少。轮廓在清楚受光的边缘与融入阴影的区域之间交替。漫射光保留圆润体积而不依赖硬描边，少量锈色点缀打断其余含蓄色域。整体处理亲密平衡，将细致观察与宽阔的空气纵深结合起来。
theme_en: White lamb beside a larger brown horned goat in a shaded mountain clearing
theme_zh: 幽暗山间林地中相伴的白色小羊与棕色有角山羊
name: Edwin Henry Landseer
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
